name: Hawk's End
description: The Hawk's End was a starship used by the Rebel Alliance under the command of Captain Magna Tolvan during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tolvan used the ship to depart from Mareti Base on the Outer Rim astronimical object Hiorin. Tolvan later used the ship to travel with her crew to a Rebel Base where General Leia Organa was based.
